CommunityApplications.Profile:
Currently: **Mealie** (self-hosted recipe manager and meal planner), moved here from the Selfhosters repository. **Print Handy** (3D print preparation and monitoring from Discord, Telegram or Matrix — one template only: Community Applications asks whether you want latest (stable), develop or nightly when you install). **TeddyCloud** (self-hosted server for your Toniebox, moved here from the Selfhosters repository). **Toduck** (local-first task manager with repeating tasks and self-hosted sync for Web and Android). **Pastey** (self-hosted paste service; catduck build with a smaller image, paste expiry controls, IPv6 whitelist support, and dark mode). **Global Law US MCP** (self-hosted MCP server for U.S. and Puerto Rico law, built on Lexifina's open global-law corpus, kept current automatically). Print Buddy was renamed to Print Handy and its old templates have been removed; install Print Handy instead.
Support for every template in this repository is in the catduck templates forum thread. Template bugs can also be reported as GitHub issues.
